{{Quote|We've got two cracked shilo pins, a damaged power converter, the engines should be fired twice to dump debris, and the backup vents need charging.|Ahsoka Tano lists Jedi Shuttle 634's mechanical problems|<ref name="Ghosts of Mortis">{{TCW|Ghosts of Mortis}}</ref>}}
'''Shilo pins''' were a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component. Among the damage sustained by [[Jedi shuttle 634/Legends|Jedi Shuttle 634]] in a crash-landing during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|visit]] to [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]] was two cracked shilo pins.<ref name="Ghosts of Mortis" />
